Without this, Android can put the app to sleep while you\'re not using the phone, and blocking stops until you reopen the app.
Open Settings → Apps → App Blocker → Battery and choose Unrestricted.

After a stop, blocking switches itself back on once this is up, so stopping is a pause you can\'t forget to undo. 0 leaves a stop as a stop.
